integrity: The proof gives an exact upper bound from the generator-column multiset and a matching generated subgroup. A standalone verifier independently enumerates all 9! coordinate permutations, all 168 row actions in GL(3,2), and the group generated by the source symmetries.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the binary code in Example 2 and does not classify automorphism groups of arbitrary SR-sums. It identifies the full coordinate-permutation group; over the binary field this also equals the monomial automorphism group.
title: Exact automorphism group of the binary SR-sum in Example 2
